   Default lease is 5s while the HTTP call may run 15s and the lease is renewed only before the call; another worker can reclaim and redeliver the job mid-flight, causing duplicate webhooks.

   Jitter is added after the cap, so a delay can reach maxDelayMs*(1+jitterRatio) (75s against the documented 60s hard ceiling); the cap test uses random=0.5 and cannot catch this.
